name: NANO Nuclear Energy Inc.
content: NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. is an advanced technology-driven nuclear energy company focused on developing portable, clean energy solutions. The company is primarily engaged in the design and development of micro-reactors, including its proprietary 'ZEUS' solid-core battery reactor and 'ODIN' low-pressure coolant reactor. Beyond reactor design, NANO Nuclear is building a comprehensive nuclear ecosystem, including fuel fabrication, transportation of nuclear materials, and consulting services. Its mission is to provide small-scale, carbon-free power for remote locations, industrial applications, and disaster relief, positioning itself as a leader in the next generation of nuclear technology.

Officers

Jay Jiang YuApril 2022

Founder and Executive Chairman

Mr. Yu is the Founder and Executive Chairman of NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. He is a serial entrepreneur and has over 16 years of experience in capital markets and corporate restructuring. He has served as a consultant to several public companies and has been involved in numerous private and public financings.

James WalkerApril 2022

Chief Executive Officer and Director

Mr. Walker is the Chief Executive Officer and a Director of NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. He has over 15 years of experience in the nuclear industry, including roles in engineering, project management, and executive leadership. He previously served as the CEO of a private nuclear technology company.

Winston ChowJanuary 2023

Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Chow is the Chief Financial Officer of NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. He has over 25 years of experience in finance and accounting, including roles as CFO and Controller for several public and private companies. He is a Certified Public Accountant.

Lassina Zerbo2024

Chairman of the Executive Advisory Board for Africa

Dr. Zerbo is the former Executive Secretary of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization (CTBTO) and has served as the Prime Minister of Burkina Faso. He is a renowned expert in nuclear non-proliferation and international diplomacy.

Robert HillMay 2023

Independent Director

Mr. Hill has over 40 years of experience in the nuclear industry, including senior leadership roles at major nuclear engineering firms. He is an expert in nuclear reactor design and safety.
